items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: The interviewee confirms the interviewer's statement that Bessie Smith was a good tipper, but provides no personal interaction or relationship with her.

ctx.x: I remember Bunk playing at Ryan's, playing beautifully at Ryan's. It was a session, I think it was one of the sessions, the Sunday sessions that Lips Page was usually playing and Bunk came in to sit in. And I remember Lips was standing at the bar and was completely moved. Bunk was playing so beautifully and Lips really did love the way Bunk played, you know. And he wouldn't even play. He wouldn't even get on the bandstand. He says, that's the man, you know. He says, I don't want to play. And it was very good. I…

We were talking the other night about Bunk in Texas and I think I told you that, if I remember rightly, that Bunk played at the American Theatre in Houston. And Lips Page was sort of a bellboy or a reporter or whatever you'd call it. But they helped him with the baggage in and out. And he always said the two biggest tippers were Bessie Smith and Bunk. I don't know if Bunk ever just came in and out or stayed there all the time. But anyway, evidently Bunk would give him good tips for helping him. I'm quite sure…
